## Investor Pressure Grows on Korean Chipmakers to Improve Shareholder Returns

Sustained return-of-capital pressure on Korea's two largest memory suppliers could accelerate buyback or dividend announcements that re-rate the equity — or, if resisted, invite proxy-related headline risk. A medium-term capital-allocation catalyst to monitor for PM exposure to either name.

- Activist and institutional investors are publicly pressing South Korean chipmakers to enhance capital returns.
- Samsung (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) are the implied subjects per classifier context.
- Coverage frames the pressure as 'growing,' suggesting escalation rather than a one-off event.
- No specific mechanism — buyback, dividend, or asset sale — is named in the headline.
